central.responsibility: Own authoritative accounts, sessions and World data; current adapter is loopback-only.

node_worker.responsibility: Execute assigned verifiable work; no direct authoritative DB writes.

launcher.responsibility: Verify signed releases and manage local server/client processes.

cli.responsibility: Send player commands using existing account authentication.

client2d.responsibility: Existing browser renderer; standalone executable planned.

client3d.responsibility: Future 3D renderer using the same player command contract.

patch_distribution.responsibility: Serve immutable signed releases; signing remains a separate restricted build step.

rewards.responsibility: Central validates contributions before authoritative Soul Digit ledger credit; no client self-awards.
